source.work: Walter Russell, The Universal One (Brieger Press, New York, c1926), "TABLE OF THE TEN OCTAVES OF THE VARYING STATES OF MOTION WHICH CREATE THE ILLUSION OF DIFFERENT SUBSTANCES KNOWN AS “THE ELEMENTS OF MATTER.”", printed pp. 92, 94, 96, 98, 100
source.loc: Library of Congress gdc.27004508, IIIF native JPEGs, images 0112/0114/0116/0118/0120
source.usp: 1974 University of Science and Philosophy reprint scan (photographic reproduction of the 1926 plates), PDF pages 110/112/114/116/118 extracted at native 2496x3488
source.chart: supplementary witness only: octave-wheel plates LoC 0109 [p.89], 0111 [p.91], 0113 [p.93], 0115 [p.95], 0117 [p.97] and frontispiece chart LoC 0016

method: Dual-witness transcription. Pass 1 (LoC scan) read first, by main-agent vision (anthropic/claude-fable-5) from native-resolution crops, tesseract 5 recorded as auxiliary. Pass 2 (USP scan) read second by an independent subagent context with no access to pass 1. Passes diffed cell-by-cell; disagreements re-examined at 4x native zoom; dash-length disputes settled by deterministic ink-run measurement. Chart labels recorded as supplementary witness, never primary. Full protocol and per-cell record: data/transcription_log_r11.md. NOTE ON INDEPENDENCE: the 1974 USP plates are photographic reproductions of the 1926 plates, so the two witnesses give scan-level independence only (independent imaging/OCR of one 1926 printing) — sufficient for what the book printed, not an independent edition.

witnesses.loc: vision anthropic/claude-fable-5 (main agent) + tesseract 5 auxiliary, read first
witnesses.usp: vision anthropic/claude-fable-5 (fresh subagent, blind to pass 1) + tesseract 5 auxiliary, read second
witnesses.chart: octave-wheel plate labels, verbatim capitals; UNKNOWN = chart prints an UNKNOWN box for that position; empty = no chart box found for that row

conventions.minus: U+2212 − for the normal printed minus (sigils and negative melting points)
conventions.long_dash: U+2014 — where the print shows a conspicuously long dash (Kr —169, Xe —140, Hg-row —39), confirmed by ink-run measurement in both witnesses
conventions.spacing: position_col/position strings are space-free canonical; the print sets a loose quad space before the sigil on letter-suffixed rows (3A +, 903E −, etc.)
conventions.typography: italic = italic name; caps = full-height capitals; smallcaps = small capitals; roman = ordinary roman type
